dialogues.speaker: Muirne
dialogues.text: Hello there. Here to check out the ocean view as well?

dialogues.speaker: Muirne
dialogues.text: My name's Muirne. You can just call me Muirne.

dialogues.speaker: Muirne
dialogues.text: Huh. I think I repeated myself there. Sorry, hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Muirne
dialogues.text: Looking at the sea brings a lot of things to my heart, and my mind moves slower, too.

dialogues.speaker: Muirne
dialogues.text: Sure you can. The view here's really nice, by the way.

dialogues.speaker: Muirne
dialogues.text: A lot of things. Sometimes I think of more and more things, and I stand for longer periods of time.

dialogues.speaker: Muirne
dialogues.text: Once, Monsieur Neuvillette saw me watching the sea, and he stood beside me in deep thought.

dialogues.speaker: Muirne
dialogues.text: And slowly, more and more people started gathering behind us.

dialogues.speaker: Muirne
dialogues.text: Everyone was tiptoeing to watch the sea, muttering to themselves, "is something happening out there?"

dialogues.speaker: Muirne
dialogues.text: But in truth, the thing I was considering was very simple. It's an everyday thing — what am I going to eat later?

dialogues.speaker: Muirne
dialogues.text: Now that we're talking about food, let me give this to you. Take it and you won't need to worry anymore.
